About The Firm

Archito Design Studio

Archito Design Studio is a multidisciplinary architecture, interior design, and construction consultancy firm headquartered in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Founded by Ar. Rushikesh Nayak, the studio has built a strong reputation for delivering innovative, functional, and aesthetically outstanding spaces across residential, commercial, hospitality, and institutional typologies.

With a team of dedicated architects, engineers, and interior designers, Archito operates as an integrated design practice — providing seamless services from initial concept through to construction supervision and project handover. The studio's approach is rooted in a deep understanding of human experience, local context, and global design sensibilities.

Archito specializes in transforming client visions into extraordinary built environments — combining advanced 3D visualization technology, parametric design thinking, and hands-on project management to deliver results that consistently exceed expectations.

🏛️ Our Philosophy
Architecture should elevate the human spirit — every design decision serves both function and beauty.
🌱 Sustainability
We integrate green design principles, passive cooling, natural light, and material efficiency into every project.
⚡ Technology
BIM workflows, parametric modeling, and photorealistic 3D visualization are central to our design process.
🤝 Collaboration
Client partnership is at the heart of everything we do — transparent communication at every stage.
🏗️
Architecture Design
We deliver complete architectural services — from site analysis and conceptual design to working drawings, approvals, and construction documentation for all building types.
🎨
Interior Design
Our interior design practice creates immersive environments through meticulous material selection, custom joinery, lighting choreography, and a deep understanding of spatial experience.
📐
Structural Engineering
Integrated structural consultancy ensures every Archito project is safe, cost-efficient, and precisely engineered — with full coordination between architectural and structural teams.
🖥️
3D Visualization
Photorealistic renders and cinematic walkthroughs communicate design intent with unparalleled clarity — helping clients visualize and approve their space before construction begins.
🌿
Landscape Design
We design outdoor environments that extend the architectural experience — from private garden courtyards to large-scale resort landscaping and urban public spaces.
🏆
Turnkey Execution
Archito offers complete project delivery under one roof — design, procurement, construction supervision, quality control, and handover — ensuring design intent is upheld throughout.

Construction Services

Construction Enquiry

Archito Design Studio offers comprehensive construction consultancy and turnkey project execution services across Odisha and beyond. Our integrated approach ensures seamless coordination between design intent and built reality — with strict quality control, transparent budgeting, and on-time delivery.

Whether you are planning a new residential build, commercial development, interior fitout, or a complete renovation — our experienced team will guide you from foundation to finish. We coordinate architects, structural engineers, MEP consultants, and skilled contractors under one unified management system.

🏠
Residential Construction
Bungalows, villas, apartments, and row houses.
🏢

Offices, showrooms, retail, and business parks.
🏨
Hospitality Construction
Hotels, resorts, restaurants, and spas.

Institutional Construction
Schools, colleges, hospitals, and public buildings.

Complete interior execution from shell to finish.

RCC design, earthquake-resistant structures, foundations.
